name: geoffcanyon
tagline: Product, code, puzzles, and whatever else won't fit in a PRD.
bio: I build AI-powered investment research tools at Arch Labs. Before that: chat design at LivePerson, experimentation tooling at Agoda, community systems at Answers.com, and a decade of building systems at HBO. This is where I write about product, code, puzzles, and whatever else won't fit in a PRD.

jobs.role: Senior Product Manager, Arch Investment Research (AIR)
jobs.line: Took AIR from zero to launch: AI that reads complex investment documents, extracts the facts, and automates the busywork around them. Also launched a product API used by 60 partners, about 35% of revenue.
Launched the platform's first commerce and marketing NLU model, adopted by 30+ major brands in year one, and lifted entity-recognition F1 by 34 points.
Set experimentation methodology for 60 PMs, shipped a booking-flow change worth about 1% of annual revenue, and coached two PMs to promotion.
Built a text-message voter-engagement platform that raised turnout by nearly 300% across state elections, then sold it to a competitor.
Led a 30-person team and launched an expert-contributor platform: 2,000 experts and 1 million answers in the first year.

Introduced project management, built a cost-of-goods-sold model that showed some partners were a drag on the company, and led the Yahoo! and AOL API implementations. Began the move into product with a page redesign that tripled click rate in testing.
Built dozens of systems, including a residuals and participation tracker.
